title: NWS Gridpoints Forecast (Data Exploration)
description: Comprehensive exploration of all 40+ NWS gridpoint forecast metrics

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(value) as value FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'temperature' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)
SELECT AVG(value) as value FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'dewpoint' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)
SELECT AVG(value) as value FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'relative_humidity' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)
SELECT AVG(value) as value FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'probability_of_precipitation' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)
SELECT AVG(value) as value FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'sky_cover' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)
SELECT AVG(value) as value FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'wind_speed' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as "Temperature", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'dewpoint' THEN value END) as "Dewpoint" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'max_temperature' THEN value END) as "Max Temp", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'min_temperature' THEN value END) as "Min Temp" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'apparent_temperature' THEN value END) as "Apparent Temp", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'heat_index' THEN value END) as "Heat Index", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wet_bulb_globe_temperature' THEN value END) as "Wet Bulb Globe" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wind_chill' THEN value END) as "Wind Chill", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as "Temperature" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'dispersion_index' THEN value END) as "Dispersion Index", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'atmospheric_dispersion_index' THEN value END) as "Atmospheric Dispersion" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Probability of Thunder & Low Visibility Risk Index

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'probability_of_thunder' THEN value END) as "Thunder Prob %", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'low_visibility_occurrence_risk_index' THEN value END) as "Low Vis Occurrence Risk" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wave_height' THEN value END) as "Wave Height (m)", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wave_period' THEN value END) as "Wave Period (s)" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wave_direction' THEN value END) as "Wave Direction" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'primary_swell_height' THEN value END) as "Primary Swell Height (m)", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'primary_swell_direction' THEN value END) as "Primary Swell Dir" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'secondary_swell_height' THEN value END) as "Secondary Swell Height (m)", AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'secondary_swell_direction' THEN value END) as "Secondary Swell Dir" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT metric, COUNT(*) as data_points, MIN(to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as earliest, MAX(to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as latest, ROUND(AVG(value), 2) as avg_value, ROUND(MIN(value), 2) as min_value, ROUND(MAX(value), 2) as max_value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-gridpoints-forecast/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY metric ORDER BY data_points DESC
